title: Mileage Tolerance on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns by Tier and Late-Charge Record
content:
**Tier benefit — mileage tolerance.** On the excess mileage charge for a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, a contract with a good late-charge record in a higher tier has tolerance miles forgiven:

- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 2, Tier 1 or Tier 1+ with at most one balloon late charge assessed in the 24 calendar months ending on the billing date has **1000 miles** forgiven;
- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 3 or Tier 4 with at most one balloon late charge assessed in those months has **500 miles** forgiven;
- every other contract, that is a Tier 5 contract or any contract with two or more late charges in those months, has no tolerance miles.

The late charges counted are the balloon late charge entries on the contract's posting history dated within the window. A window of 24 calendar months ending on the billing date takes in the dates on or before the billing date that fall fewer than 24 whole calendar months before it; whole calendar months from one date to another are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

## Tolerance table

| Tier | 0 late charges in the 24 months | 1 late charge | 2 or more late charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 1+, Tier 1, Tier 2 | 1000 miles | 1000 miles | None |
| Tier 3, Tier 4 | 500 miles | 500 miles | None |
| Tier 5 | None | None | None |

## Window edge (hypothetical dates)

Billing on 15 June of a year: a late charge dated 16 June two years earlier is fewer than 24 whole months before and is counted; one dated 15 June two years earlier is exactly 24 whole months before and is not counted.
